text:
Sam Rivera: silly question for the lunch crowd  - if our fridge had an assistant persona, what would it be?
Lina Gomez: The Passive Sous-Chef. Gives recipe hints but never cooks. :knife_fork_plate: 
Owen Park: Definitely "FridgeGPT" that only answers in one-liners and keeps asking for clarifying snack context.
Maya Rao: poll options: A) Passive Sous-Chef B) FridgeGPT (one-liner) C) Refrigerator of Bureaucracy D) Snack Oracle E) Cold Stoic
Sam Rivera: Vote with emoji. I'm biased toward Snack Oracle. :crystal_ball: 
Lina Gomez: imagine the fridge replying to "Who took my salad?" with: ```assistant: "Based on door-open telemetry, 12:02pm, you are not the most attentive caregiver."``` :laughing: 
fridge-bot: TEMP UPDATE: 40C, last door event: Mike (kitchen-key) 9 mins ago. :fridge: 
Owen Park: fridge-bot is already doing the paperwork. we live in the future. :sunglasses: 
Maya Rao: also, what would the system prompt on the sticky note say? best one wins a cup of instant coffee. :coffee:
Lina Gomez: "system: be concise. assistant: judge no one, but comment on leftovers."
Sam Rivera: "system: optimize for freshness. assistant: mark items as 'probably belongs to someone named Steve' if unlabeled."
Owen Park: "system: maximize snack accessibility. assistant: hide the last cookie behind kale." :kale:
fridge-bot: ANECDOTAL LOG: someone left a note 'do not eat - science'. item status: eaten. :crying_cat_face:
Maya Rao: ok results so far (emoji tally): :crystal_ball: Snack Oracle (5), :fridge: FridgeGPT (3), :thought_balloon: Cold Stoic (1). biased sample.
Sam Rivera: thread wrap - lunch adjudication committee will pick winner and award coffee. thanks for the chaos. :trophy:
